name: mg-harness
description: Claude Code skills and harness rituals for engineering leaders. Auto-triggered skills for triage, briefings, and handoffs — plus slash commands, hooks, and subagents for long-running, multi-session work.

verify_command.title: Verify command
verify_command.description: Shell command run before every Edit/Write tool call (PreToolUse hook). Should exit 0 on success, non-zero on failure. Examples: 'npm run lint --silent', 'pnpm typecheck', 'cargo check --quiet'. Leave empty to disable.

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: Shell command run by /mg-harness:verify. Examples: 'npm test --silent', 'pytest -q', 'cargo test --quiet'. Leave empty to skip the test step.

drift_check_enabled.title: Enable drift check
drift_check_enabled.description: Re-inject the current plan into context on every prompt (UserPromptSubmit hook) to combat drift.

open_pr_with_gh.title: Open PR with gh
open_pr_with_gh.description: If true and the GitHub CLI (gh) is installed, /mg-harness:finish-work will open a PR automatically.
